tagline: Generate a JSON Schema from a real JSON sample in one click
pageDescription: Turn any JSON sample into a valid JSON Schema with this free, browser-based generator. Paste an object, an array or a raw API response and get draft-07 or 2020-12 output with types, required keys and detected string formats. Array items are merged, so a key missing from some elements stays optional instead of over-constraining your schema. Built for developers writing API contracts and request validation. Everything runs locally — your payload is never uploaded. No signup.

instructions.title: How to generate a JSON Schema

steps.title: Paste your JSON sample
steps.description: Drop in an object, an array of records or a raw API response. Click 'Load sample' to see how a two-record array is handled.

steps.title: Pick the draft
steps.description: Draft-07 is the safest default and what most validators (Ajv, python-jsonschema) expect. Choose 2020-12 for OpenAPI 3.1 and newer tooling.

steps.title: Decide what is required
steps.description: 'All present keys' marks every key found in the sample as required. Switch to 'None' when the sample is only partial and you'll tighten the schema by hand.

steps.title: Toggle formats, examples and strictness
steps.description: Format detection adds date-time, date, time, email, uri, uuid and ipv4 annotations. 'No extra properties' emits additionalProperties: false; 'Include examples' keeps the sampled value on each scalar.

steps.title: Generate, then copy or download
steps.description: Click Generate schema to see the result plus object, property and depth counts. Copy it or download it as a .json file ready to commit next to your API code.

features: Draft-07 and 2020-12 output with the correct $schema URL
Array items merged into one schema — required narrows to the shared keys
Integer vs number detection, and nullable values as type lists
String format detection: date-time, date, time, email, uri, uuid, ipv4
Optional additionalProperties: false for strict contracts
Optional examples and a custom schema title
Converts JSON to JSON Schema by inferring types from the sample data
Stats on objects, properties, nesting depth and formats found
100% client-side — your JSON payload never leaves the browser, no signup
useCases: Write a JSON Schema for an API response you only have a sample of
Generate a validation schema for Ajv or python-jsonschema
Draft an OpenAPI 3.1 request body schema from a real payload
Document the shape of a webhook payload for your team
Add contract tests that fail when an upstream API changes shape
Build a config-file schema so editors autocomplete and validate it
Check which fields are actually optional across a list of records
Bootstrap a schema for a NoSQL collection dump
proTips: Paste several records, not one — that is how optional keys are discovered
Include a record with nulls so nullable fields come out as type lists
Use 'No extra properties' when the schema guards an incoming request
Turn off format detection if IDs in your data look like dates or UUIDs by accident
Set a title matching your type name to keep generated docs readable
Need TypeScript types instead? Use the JSON to TypeScript tool
troubleshooting: Invalid JSON error: the sample must be strict JSON — run it through JSON Repair first
Everything came out required: switch 'Required keys' to None, or paste more records
A field is typed too narrowly: add samples covering its other values, then regenerate
Unexpected format on an ID: disable format detection, UUID-like strings are annotated by design
Empty array became items: {}: there was nothing to infer from — add one example element
